blocks.text: For Filipinos, Christmas is a season to look forward to: a time for reunions, potlucks, thoughtful gifts, and familiar meals shared with family and friends. This year, Pancake House welcomes everyone to make it their Home for the Holidays with Holiday, Everyday, a nod to the food and moments that bring people together.For over five decades, Pancake House has served comforting favorites to generations of families. With over 100 stores nationwide, its all-day menu makes it easy to gather over a favorite meal, bring familiar flavors to a hometown trip, or make an office party and Noche Buena plan feel more […]...
